title: Where Is Button?
refrain: Max and Lily and Biscuit look everywhere
notes: Story bible for the bundled example, written from make_book.py: captions and titles are copied verbatim, and each beat's anchors record what the page actually draws (x < ~340 left, > ~510 right). Check it with: python3 -m lib.story examples/where-is-button/story.json

outside.desc: the Harper house from the garden

hallway.desc: the hallway to the front door

party_room.desc: the room the family celebrates in

beats.title: Trace Your Names!
beats.caption: Trace the letters. M-A-X spells Max. L-I-L-Y spells Lily. Color a dinosaur for Max and a butterfly for Lily!

beats.title: Meet the Harpers
beats.caption: This is Max. This is Lily. This is Biscuit the dog. Max and Lily love their teddy bear Button, who goes everywhere with them.

beats.title: Where Is Button?
beats.caption: Oh no! Button is not on the bed. Where is Button? Max and Lily and Biscuit look everywhere. Come and help Max and Lily search!

beats.title: Look in the Bedroom
beats.caption: Max looks under the bed. Lily peeks in the toy box. Biscuit sniffs the soft blanket. Button is not here! Max and Lily keep looking.

beats.title: Look in the Living Room
beats.caption: Now Max and Lily look in the living room. Lily checks behind the big chair. Max lifts the couch cushions. Where is Button hiding?

beats.title: Follow Biscuit!
beats.caption: Max and Lily and Biscuit look everywhere! Biscuit points his nose down the hallway. Can you find five butterflies to color?

beats.title: Where Would YOU Hide Button?
beats.note: creativity pause in the almost-there slot: the reader draws the hiding spot (no setback in the art)
beats.caption: Max and Lily think and think. Where would YOU hide Button? Draw a hiding spot for Button in the big cloud!

beats.title: Biscuit Found Him!
beats.caption: Biscuit found him! Button is under Max's bed. Max reaches down and pulls Button out. Lily claps and cheers. Good dog, Biscuit!

beats.title: Hooray for Button!
beats.caption: Max and Lily and Biscuit found Button! Everyone dances in a happy circle. Now Max and Lily snuggle into bed with Button.

beats.note: goodnight vignette: Button and Biscuit asleep on the rug; the goodnight lines are drawn text, not a caption
